status.value: Partial rendering only. The USA PS3 EBOOT (BLUS30569) now runs as a native Windows x86-64 executable and draws the Scaleform attract/legal screen through D3D12 at 1280×720 (the README reports 32 FPS telemetry); some dynamic text is garbled. It remains on the logo-video screen because the CRI movie-decoding/SPU task path is not implemented, so gameplay has not been reached.

sources.label: Maintainer README: current boot/render status, title ID, and CRI video frontier

summary.value: Statically lifts the user's decrypted USA PS3 EBOOT.elf (BLUS30569) from PowerPC64 to C/C++ and links it against ps3recomp's native HLE/runtime libraries. The repository contains analysis metadata and the recompilation harness, not game binaries, audio, or other game content. Its current renderer draws the game's own Scaleform attract/legal screen, but it does not yet advance into gameplay.

sources.label: Maintainer README: recompilation method, target, and current rendering
